note: BH-8473: the seconds the pre-queue fast lint hook keeps back from the gate's call budget left (MC_PREQUEUE_CALL_BUDGET_S). The set's budget is never more than the budget left minus this reserve, so pq_call's bound never cuts the hook mid-run. When the budget left minus the reserve is under 1 s, the hook answers could-not-run and the row goes on. Per project: lane.merge-conductor.<project>.mc_prequeue_fast_lints_reserve_s.
